title: privacy policy to get updated to the native language
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

![Screenshot (65)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/102183018/197835962-067f8ed7-494a-48ad-b3b8-cb5686489d4b.png)
The privacy page is in German. I faced problem while translating it to my native language.

### Describe the solution you'd like

I really liked the concept of the website. It is a rare resource. If only this webpage has an option where the language could be translated into the native language just below the page as you scroll down.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

_No response_

_No response_
